newsitem.title: USA: Rubin says U.S. can afford tax cuts in budget pact.
newsitem.headline: Rubin says U.S. can afford tax cuts in budget pact.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Friday said the nation can afford the net tax cut of $85 billion over five years in the budget agreement because of the health of the U.S. economy.
In a briefing for reporters on the budget accord with the Republicans, Rubin said it "was a tax cut that we can afford because of the economic growth, the economic success."

Rubin also said there was protection against an explosion of tax cuts in the second five years, which he called extremely important, "in terms of making sure we don't get back into an era like we had in the 1980s."
